commits.title: feat(rec-c1.5): canonical ExecutionLog root resolver
commits.summary: Added chronos-log::location::{resolve_execution_log_root, execution_log_dir} (OnceLock-backed, memoized) plus the cfg(test) set_execution_log_root_for_testing seam. Migrated session create, bootstrap, and durable delete to read through it.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): edge cases for the canonical ExecutionLog root resolver
commits.summary: Env round-trip, two-call equality, override seam, default-fallback determinism.

commits.title: feat(rec-c1.5): bootstrap execution logs during MCP startup
commits.summary: try_new now calls bootstrap_execution_logs before returning. Surface typed ChronosServerInitError::ExecutionLogBootstrap on failure.

commits.title: feat(rec-c1.5): make session deletion remove durable logs
commits.summary: SessionsService::delete_session now also removes the durable ExecutionLog on disk via delete_durable_execution_log. DeleteResult.paths_removed surfaces what was deleted.

commits.title: feat(rec-c1.5): durably seal logs on clean session stop
commits.summary: Clean-stop path now writes tail_state=Sealed to the manifest; restart reads Sealed and skips the bootstrap reopen path. UAT-R3 proves this.

commits.title: feat(rec-c1.5): expose durable deletion paths
commits.summary: Surface delete_durable_execution_log in SessionExecutionLogRegistry::remove so the durable side is exercised before filesystem removal.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): add two-process sealed restart UAT
commits.summary: r3_clean_session_stop_seals_and_restart_bootstraps_it: A emits → session_stop(true,true) → B sees tail_state=Sealed + identical events page.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): add durable delete restart UAT
commits.summary: r4_delete_session_is_absent_after_restart: A creates session → A deletes it → B sees SessionNotFound (or Unavailable), never the deleted logs.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): add real-process unclean restart UAT
commits.summary: Added McpTestClient::force_kill helper. r1_unclean_restart_reproduces_same_events_page: A emits → SIGKILL A → B reads identical events pages + manifest tail_state != Sealed.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): add identical-stale restart UAT
commits.summary: r2_stale_cursor_is_identical_before_and_after_restart: pre-seed retained_from=5, A reads seq=0 → CursorStale, B reads seq=0 → same CursorStale numbers.

commits.title: test(rec-c1.5): add try_new readiness invariant
commits.summary: Add ChronosServer::execution_log_registry accessor (Arc<SessionExecutionLogRegistry>). Added bootstrap_readiness integration test that seeds two sessions, calls try_new, asserts registry.len()==2 and both ids present. Regression-verified by commenting bootstrap out — test fails with len=0.

gates.smoke_subset_note: Per AGENTS.md §2 the subset was selected from diff scope: this cycle exclusively touches chronos-log, chronos-services, chronos-mcp, and chronos-sandbox (the test of executable boundary). restart_uat exercises the changed boundary; e2e_connectivity confirms server start; analytics_tools confirms read paths under the new bootstrap shape.

notes: Pre-cycle see previous checkpoint at e2cd57a5; head_sha updated post-R5 commit (a2aee5b9) and post-style cleanup (1a1ec68a).
